item.title: Design Contest
item.description: Looking for advice on how to put the word out that we are launching a T-Shirt Design contest for our company. Hoping the prize of the winning designers becoming partners with us in the success of their designs is an exciting opportunity. Most contest sites pay only a couple of hundred dollars. We are looking for these designers to benefit from each and every item sold with their design. Also hoping some will eventually come and work for the company.
